name: Neural Pre-Integrated Lighting (Neural-PIL)
definition: A neural network that replaces the costly numerical integration of incoming light with a simple network query, predicting pre-integrated light L̃i(ωr, br) directly from illumination embedding, direction, and roughness.
summary: Neural-PIL replaces costly numerical integration with a neural network query to efficiently predict pre-integrated light, capturing fine illumination details without the high memory costs of spherical harmonic representations.
